# Задача: обход ext4

В образе ext4 есть файл с уликой. Разбери суперблок, найди inode-таблицу через
дескриптор группы, обойди extent-дерево корневого каталога и прочитай содержимое
файла. Запиши флаг в `found.txt`.

# Walk a real ext4 image: superblock -> inode table -> root dir -> file content.
import struct, sys
FN = "disk.img"
img = open(FN, "rb").read()
sb = 1024
assert struct.unpack_from("<H", img, sb + 0x38)[0] == 0xEF53, "no ext4 superblock"
log_bs = struct.unpack_from("<I", img, sb + 0x18)[0]
block = 1024 << log_bs
inode_size = struct.unpack_from("<H", img, sb + 0x58)[0]
first_data = struct.unpack_from("<I", img, sb + 0x14)[0]
gdt = (first_data + 1) * block
inode_table = struct.unpack_from("<I", img, gdt + 0x08)[0]
print("block size =", block, " inode size =", inode_size, " inode table =", inode_table)

def read_inode(n):
    off = inode_table * block + (n - 1) * inode_size
    return img[off:off + inode_size]

def inode_blocks(ino):
    d = read_inode(ino)
    flags = struct.unpack_from("<I", d, 0x20)[0]
    out = []
    if flags & 0x80000:                       # EXT4_EXTENTS_FL
        magic, entries, mx, depth = struct.unpack("<HHHH", d[40:48])
        assert magic == 0xF30A
        for i in range(entries):
            ee = d[40 + 12 + i * 12:40 + 12 + i * 12 + 12]
            ee_block, ee_len, hi, lo = struct.unpack("<IHHI", ee)
            start = (hi << 32) | lo
            out.append((start, ee_len & 0x7FFF))
    return out

def dir_entries(ino):
    res = []
    for (start, ln) in inode_blocks(ino):
        blk = img[start * block:(start + ln) * block]
        p = 0
        while p + 8 <= len(blk):
            e_ino, rec_len, name_len, ftype = struct.unpack_from("<IHBB", blk, p)
            if rec_len == 0:
                break
            name = blk[p + 8:p + 8 + name_len]
            if e_ino and name not in (b".", b".."):
                res.append((e_ino, name.decode("latin-1")))
            p += rec_len
    return res

for ino, name in dir_entries(2):              # inode 2 = root directory
    print("dir entry: inode=%d name=%s" % (ino, name))
    for (start, ln) in inode_blocks(ino):
        chunk = img[start * block:(start + ln) * block]
        txt = chunk.decode("latin-1", "ignore")
        if "nto{" in txt:
            line = [l for l in txt.splitlines() if "nto{" in l][0]
            print("recovered file content:", line)
